verdict.rationale: Integer quantization is a fair axis for an on-device inference SDK like RunAnywhere. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions quantization formats, bit-widths, or memory-footprint reduction. The only related material covers model download sizes, NPU and Metal acceleration, and kernel validation, none of which documents low-bit to 8-bit integer quantization.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
